blockers.wanted: high flatness together with centroid 2-6 kHz
blockers.tried: wide-q band-passed noise ticks, low-pass removed or opened to 14-20 kHz; centroid 4-6k gave flatness 0.01-0.06, flatness 0.28 only with centroid 7k+ and no low-pass
blockers.workaround: settled at centroid ~5.7 kHz, flatness ~0.06; flatness appears to be measured over linear bins up to Nyquist so a tilted spectrum reads as tonal; manual does not say

blockers.tried: 12 ticks 24 ms apart (reported 5 onsets), 50 quiet dust ticks added (10 -> 7 onsets)
blockers.workaround: 10 loud ticks 42 ms apart with quiet dust; onset detector has an undocumented ~40 ms minimum spacing, so the step is slower than real gravel

blockers.wanted: run only the onsets check from verify
blockers.tried: verify {checks:[...]}, {only:[...]}, {bogus:1}: all silently ignored, default checks ran
blockers.workaround: use sound_ops `expect` {onsets:{min:8}} (found by guessing); the format is not in the manual

blockers.wanted: a macro for fine-dust amount with a claim that matches
blockers.tried: claim flatness +1 (flat, no move), swing -1 (it rose)
blockers.workaround: renamed to scatter with claim swing +1; claim is required (macro without claim: 'missing field claim') though the manual reads as optional

blockers.wanted: macros that drive the per-voice patch (tick decay time, bandpass centre)
blockers.tried: macro maps are node/field only; patch nodes are not addressable
blockers.workaround: macros on gain nodes and a post low-pass outside the voices

wishlist: onsets descriptor with a documented / settable min spacing, plus a per-event count from the event stream
flatness measured within the active band (or a band-limited flatness)
macro maps that can write voices patch params or $params used in a voices map
what_worked: pattern/burst -> voices with a $rand-mapped band-pass made the crunch in one batch
listen waveform image shows each tick clearly
macro sweep in verify gives measured claims; expect in sound_ops reports onsets
